note: Triennial election of Omagh Rural District Council, polled Thursday 1 June 1961. There was no contest in the district: all 39 members were returned unopposed after Mr. Fred Giboney withdrew in Bencran. Mr. Fred Giboney, nominated as an unofficial Unionist, withdrew his candidature and Mr. M'Ivor was returned unopposed. Returned unopposed.
correctionNote: Renamed from 'Bencran' to Bancran (19 Nov 2026, w19-tidy, the owner's decision 4 of 19 Nov 2026: a division filed under two spellings takes its official name, and each round keeps the spelling it was filed under as Constituency_Name_As_Printed): the Northern Ireland DED maps of 1925-69 name the DED Bancran; the rounds were filed as Bencran (1924, 1927, 1930, 1933, 1936, 1939, 1946, 1949, 1955, 1958, 1961, 1964, 1967); Benchran (1952). This round was filed as 'Bencran', kept as Constituency_Name_As_Printed; the old address (bencran) answers with a redirect to this one.
